sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Tallinn Design Festival / Disainiöö returns from 28 September to 4 October 2026 for its 21st edition, bringing together contemporary Estonian design, international designers, exhibitions, talks, installations, workshops and city-wide events. Taking place primarily at Põhjala Factory, a former industrial complex in northern Tallinn, this year’s festival focuses on the theme “Future of Product Design”. The programme asks a fundamental question: in a world already filled with products, what should designers create next?
